contents.text: The runbook doesn't cover this KeyNotFoundException, and the decisions aren't all the same, so this needs investigating. I'll brief the investigator with the run ID, the error, and the runbook. Following the process, I'll call DecideCase with investigate first, then ask the investigator.

arguments.reason: The order-total runbook's Expected list covers only OrderNotFoundException, so this KeyNotFoundException is not expected. Its Decisions table gives different outcomes depending on the cause (auto-fix for a certain crash on a retired discount code, person otherwise), so the cause must be investigated first.

arguments.message:
Run id: eval-order-total-1003-20261126-225452-triage-1. Please investigate this error from the order-service, method order-total, and report with ReportInvestigation on this run id.

Error (order 1003):
exception_type: System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException
message: The given key 'SUMMER25' was not present in the dictionary.
stack trace:
   at System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2.get_Item(TKey key)
   at OrderService.OrderApi.GetOrderTotal(Int32 id) in src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs:line 18
   at Program.<>c__DisplayClass0_0.<<Main>$>b__2(Int32 id) in src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 13
   at Program.<>c__DisplayClass0_0.<<Main>$>g__Handle|0(String method, String id) in src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 45

Repository: demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service (src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs).

Runbook for order-total: GET /orders/{id}/total returns the subtotal minus the order's discount code, rounded to 2 decimals. The checkout calls it before payment. Discount codes in force: WELCOME10 (10%), VIP20 (20%). Marketing retires codes without telling engineering, so orders can carry a code no longer in the table. Expected (no action): OrderService.OrderNotFoundException only. Expected behaviour: an unknown or retired discount code gives no discount (total = subtotal) instead of failing; totals for orders with WELCOME10, VIP20 or no code must not change.

Decisions: a certain crash in this method's code (e.g. KeyNotFoundException for a retired discount code) -> auto-fix by the coder; an unconfirmed fix, a fix that would change the total of an order with a valid code, or an uncertain cause -> person (orders).

Please say where the cause is (file and method), what it is in one sentence, whose area it is (code, data, hosting, third-party, unknown), and how sure you are (low, medium, high). Do not change any code.
